QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_39

question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations and the Code of Conduct chapter, any change in Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of an AIF shall be intimated to:

answer.text: Only to the Registrar of Companies

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per the chapter: AIFs must disclose all KMP and investment-manager names in the PPM. Any change in KMP 'shall be intimated to the investors AND SEBI'. The dual-reporting ensures both investor transparency and regulatory oversight. **The Trap:** Either-only options miss the other. RoC filing is a separate Companies Act requirement, not the AIF-specific KMP rule. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests KMP disclosure. XXI-B tests similar PMS disclosure. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Pre-draft a KMP-change template that goes simultaneously to investors (email + SCORES) and SEBI. Attach a one-pager on 'continuity of key person' to quell LP concerns — key-person clauses can trigger suspensions if not managed.
